data.narrative: Learner demonstrated mastery of context engineering by structuring a layered context architecture, formalizing explicit 'If Omitted' failure modes for each task bundle, diagnosing an abstraction gap between prose error rules and concrete code patterns, and implementing a centralized DomainError layer backed by 17 passing tests.

dimension_scores.observation: Constructed exhaustive context packages combining system-level architectural constitutions with curated task-specific bundles and strict line-budget guardrails.
dimension_scores.evidence: Authored system-context.md and task-bundles.md with explicit 'If Omitted' risk justifications across Tasks 1-3.

dimension_scores.observation: Systematically audited first-pass code against repo conventions, identifying that free-form Error throws in authz.js and token.js violated the client-facing error schema.
dimension_scores.evidence: Identified that requireTeamRole() and digestInvitationToken() threw bare Error objects lacking structured error codes, causing downstream client deserialization breakage.

dimension_scores.observation: Closed the abstraction gap in a single iteration by designing a shared DomainError class, refactoring affected modules, and achieving 100% green test passes.
dimension_scores.evidence: Implemented src/services/errors.js, updated authz.js and token.js, and brought the test suite from 14 to 17 passing tests without external libraries.

dimension_scores.observation: Exhibited mature systems intuition by articulating the fundamental context engineering law: showing a concrete code pattern outperforms stating an abstract rule every time.
dimension_scores.evidence: Traced the convention violation to an abstraction gap where the prompt gave the rule but not the tool, resolving it with a concrete domain utility.

dimension_scores.observation: Delivered clean, modular Node.js v22 ESM code with zero external dependencies, strict input validation, timing-safe crypto, and 100% test pass rate.
dimension_scores.evidence: node --test tests/*.test.js executed with 17 pass, 0 fail across store, authz, token, and error test suites.

strengths: Mastery of the Context Triangle (Architectural, Local, and Constraint contexts), preventing pattern averaging and context pollution
Rigorous 'If Omitted' dependency auditing to keep prompts lean and high-signal
Deep understanding of API consistency and structured domain error handling
growth_areas: Apply line-by-line adversarial code review in Module 04 to detect subtle logic inversions and silent regressions in AI-generated code
data.recommendation: Advance to Module 04 (The Review Discipline) to master adversarial code review, diff verification, and spot-checking silent failure modes.
